name: BlindMatrix e-Commerce
author: Blindmatrix Ecommerce

sections.description:
BlindMatrix e-Commerce is a complete solution for selling blinds, curtains, and shutters online. It transforms your website into a fully functional e-commerce platform with a built-in product visualizer.

Customers can customize products and preview them in real-time using a 3D visualizer directly on the product page, creating an immersive shopping experience that boosts conversions and reduces returns.

Live Demos

See BlindMatrix in action:

Demo 1 – Classic Experience

A clean and simple blinds store layout
View Demo 1

Demo 2 – Modern UI Experience

A stylish and modern curtain showcase
View Demo 2

Demo 3 – 3D Visualizer Experience

Interactive product customization with 3D preview
View Demo 3

Features

  • Full e-commerce functionality for blinds, curtains, and shutters
  • Interactive 3D product visualizer on product pages
  • Real-time customization (size, color, fabric, and style)
  • Dynamic pricing based on user selections
  • Product preview on window frames
  • Mobile-friendly and responsive design
  • Lightweight and optimized for performance
  • Easy integration with WordPress themes

Product Customization Options

  • Width and height (custom sizing)
  • Fabric and material selection
  • Colors and patterns
  • Mount type (inside or outside)
  • Control options (manual or motorized)

3D Visualizer

The built-in 3D visualizer allows customers to:

  • Rotate and zoom products
  • Change materials and colors in real-time
  • Preview products in a realistic environment
  • Experience near real-life visualization before purchase

Contributors

  • Blindmatrix e-Commerce
sections.installation:
From WordPress backend

  1. Navigate to Plugins -> Add new.
  2. Click the button “Upload Plugin” next to “Add plugins” title.
  3. Upload the window-blinds-solution.zip file and activate it.

Direct upload

  1. Upload the downloaded zip file into your wp-content/plugins/ folder.
  2. Unzip the uploaded zip file.
  3. Navigate to Plugins menu on your WordPress admin area.
  4. Activate this plugin.
sections.faq:
Can I use the visualizer on mobile devices?

Yes, the visualizer is fully responsive and works on mobile, tablet, and desktop devices.

Can I customize product pricing?

Yes, pricing updates dynamically based on selected options like size, material, and features.

Is coding knowledge required?

No, the plugin is designed to be user-friendly and works out of the box.
